description.text: Federal Reserve Transparency Act of 2025 This bill directs the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to complete an audit of the Federal Reserve Board and Federal Reserve banks not later than 12 months after enactment. In addition, the bill allows the GAO to audit the Federal Reserve Board and Federal Reserve banks with respect to (1) international financial transactions; (2) deliberations, decisions, or actions on monetary policy matters; (3) transactions made under the direction of the Federal Open Market Committee; and (4) discussions or communications among Federal Reserve officers, board members, and employees regarding any of these matters.

latestAction.text: Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. Hearings held.

aiDescription.summary: The bill directs the Comptroller General to audit the Board of Governors and all Federal Reserve banks and report findings and recommendations within 12 months. It repeals statutory audit limits and explicitly authorizes GAO audits of international transactions, monetary policy deliberations, FOMC transactions, related communications, and Fed facilities.

impact.summary: The Comptroller General (GAO) must complete an audit within 12 months of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and the 12 Federal Reserve banks and submit a report to Congress. GAO may audit FOMC actions, Section 13(3) programs, and Fed communications.
